description: Uniform-colour ramp in the documented colour space Raw: 288 values (k/255 for k = 0..255 and (k + 0.5)/255 for every eighth k), three per channel, spread over 24 texture sets, each value on an RGB16 channel (User0-3) and an sRGB8 channel (User4-7), for the transfer-function fit (04 section 4).
